DOCUMENT_TITLE: Ease of Doing Investment (EoDI)- Disclosure of registered name and registration number by SEBI regulated entities and their agents on Social Media Platforms (SMPs)
TEXT: SEBI requires SEBI-regulated entities and their agents to disclose their registered name and registration number on applicable social media platforms.
VERSION_NOTES: Official SEBI circular dated 26 February 2026, titled “Ease of Doing Investment (EoDI)- Disclosure of registered name and registration number by SEBI regulated entities and their agents on Social Media Platforms (SMPs),” located on the SEBI website. SEBI's published summary states that the disclosure requirement starts on 1 May 2026. Check for subsequent amendments or clarifications before treating this as fully current guidance.
